notes: No divergence: PTQ1_0 ARM vs x86 within 0.03% PPL; ik_llama.cpp vs prism KLD ~2e-4 on PQ2_0 (2 windows).
Greedy text can change with the CPU or the engine on a near-tie, with the same file and prompt. This is expected from the natural spread (~1% of positions change top-1), but visible to users.
On x86 without AVX-512, PTQ1_0 (the smaller file) is ~6x slower than PQ2_0 in prompt processing with prism (no fast PTQ1_0 path on x86; PrismML-Eng/llama.cpp#324).
ik_llama.cpp is faster than prism only with -rtr (run-time repack): 1.85x prompt, 2.41x generation on PQ2_0. Without it, prompt processing is 3.5x slower. -rtr is not the default.
ik_llama.cpp labels this PQ2_0 file 'IQ5_K - 5.5 bpw': general.file_type 141 means PQ2_0 in prism and IQ5_K in ik_llama.cpp. Label only; tensors are read by their own type (142).
PQ2_0 was not run on the ARM VM (7.2 GB file, RAM limit). AVX-512 CPUs (where prism documents a PQ2_0 crash, #180) were not available.
PPL and KL: 5 of 5 identical to the values above.
